Victor, I'm sorry. Nothing has moved. Your Thor P2 is still packed and reserved at Chattanooga on a hold, and the reason is worse than I told you: our warehouse has no record of your BS-2 return at all, even though UPS delivered it on October 20. That's entirely on us.

I've put that in front of the team right now, with the delivery date, to get the unit booked in and your Thor P2 released. Stay in the chat if you can, otherwise it comes to your email.

Two things, in order. The team books your returned BS-2 in against the RMA, which clears the Manual hold on Shop····. Once that lifts, your Thor P2 ships from Chattanooga in 1 to 2 business days and the tracking comes to this email automatically.

They're on now and have it with your October 20 delivery date. Stay in the chat if you can and they'll pick it up here; if you step away, the answer reaches you by email.

I won't give you a date I don't control, Victor, you've had enough of those. The team is on right now and this is in front of them with your delivery date, so realistically today or tomorrow. The moment the hold lifts, the Thor P2 goes out of Chattanooga within 1 to 2 business days and the tracking emails to you.

If nothing has landed in your inbox by tomorrow afternoon, come back here and I'll chase it again.
